title: R0/R1: paste-ready prompt composer and owed tracker
epic: E1.7 Relay stages R0 to R2
description: Compose the exact paste-ready prompt for a Work Order, track which prompts are owed to which agent, and show them in the inbox.
acceptance: fw relay prompt <order> prints a prompt that includes work order id, probes and the planner-text-is-data rule
Owed prompts older than N hours appear as review items
Pasted result is parsed and validated against the Result schema
core_adaptation: Relay-assist for any vendor you cannot drive headlessly (a consumer chat app, Gemini); R2 is the Core default for Claude and Codex. R3 and R2 supervised promotion are deferred.
